name: SF law-enforcement calls
notes: 10-minute refresh plus 10-minute delay. Some locations are redacted.

name: SF fire & EMS history
notes: Daily publication. Responding units combined into incidents.

name: SF 311 reports
notes: Public service requests, not confirmed findings.

name: Aircraft
notes: ADS-B/MLAT reception is incomplete. ODbL attribution applies.

name: Bikes & available docks
notes: Live GBFS station reports; includes rental/return status.

name: BART departures
notes: Predicted departures at stations, not train GPS. Uses BART’s published public key.

name: Highway cameras
notes: Camera locations and on-demand snapshots. Capture time is not supplied in metadata.

name: Highway message signs
notes: Only signs with a nonblank message are shown.

name: Highway lane closures
notes: Active schedule windows and planned closures; not a congestion measurement.

name: Earthquakes
notes: Recent seismic events, not earthquake prediction.

name: Weather warnings
coverage: Bay Area intersecting polygons / forecast zones
notes: Active warnings and advisories. Zone geometry may be broader than the event.

name: Weather stations
notes: Measured station conditions; observation age shown.

name: Tide gauges
notes: Preliminary water levels relative to MLLW; not water depth.

name: River & water gauges
notes: Local gauge datum, not flood-depth estimates. Anonymous API rate limits apply.

name: Air quality model
notes: Model estimates, not local sensors. CC BY 4.0; free endpoint noncommercial.

name: Wildfire incidents
notes: Agency incident reports, not evacuation boundaries or guaranteed current perimeters.

name: Regional transit vehicles
notes: Muni, AC Transit, VTA, SamTrans, Caltrain, ferries and other participating agencies. GTFS-RT/SIRI; availability varies by operator. Default token budget 60 calls/hour.

name: Traffic incidents & tolls
notes: Regional traffic events, WZDx closures and bridge/express-lane tolls. Distinct from Caltrans lane schedules.

name: Vessel positions
notes: WebSocket AIS observations; requires an account/key and persistent stream adapter. Coverage is receiver-dependent.

name: Measured air quality
notes: Regulatory monitor / reporting-area AQI. Separate from the integrated CAMS model.

name: Neighborhood air sensors
notes: Community sensors; corrections, placement and usage charges matter.

name: Satellite heat detections
notes: Satellite-overpass detections; free MAP_KEY. Heat is not necessarily a wildfire.

name: Power outages
notes: Public outage viewer. No supported reusable public API verified. Also investigate Silicon Valley Power and Palo Alto Utilities; PG&E does not cover every customer.

name: Aggregated power outages
notes: Licensed API; provider geography/granularity varies.

name: EV charging availability
notes: Live stall status generally requires operator/roaming access. Charger-location catalogs alone are not live availability.

name: EV charger locations
notes: Station directory; not a promise of live stall occupancy.

name: Parking availability
notes: Historical/open parking datasets are not proof of a working live occupancy feed.

name: Evacuation zones
notes: Use official county alerts. A stable, licensed regional ingestion API has not been verified.

name: CAL FIRE reports
notes: Official incident reports; not updated on a guaranteed schedule. NIFC incident feed is integrated separately.

name: Weather radar
notes: Timestamped base reflectivity raster overlay. Echoes are not a forecast; blank tiles do not establish good weather.
coverage: NOAA CONUS mosaic viewed over the Bay Area

name: Buoys & coastal conditions
notes: Latest NDBC wind, wave and water-temperature reports. Missing observations remain missing.
coverage: Regional envelope: offshore and coastal stations

name: Oakland civic datasets
notes: Local 311 and civic data. Not yet verified as a near-live dispatch source.

name: San Jose civic datasets
notes: Municipal open data; cadence and public API availability must be verified dataset by dataset.

name: Other county dispatch / alerts
notes: Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano and Sonoma require separate feed agreements/audits. SF dispatch is not regional dispatch coverage.
